reviewNotes: KRF.Tags is treated as reserved even with zero ClientVisible definitions. Sections 1/36 reserve the id, while section 6 omits its protocol domain; duplicate detection alone cannot enforce reservation when the built-in definition is absent.

Performance assertions enforce touched-tag adapter queries, stable unrelated anchors, narrow N3 Map patches, and no countdown traffic. Current N3 PublicationCapture still walks/measures the complete Map; end-to-end O(touched tags) requires a separate N3 optimization.
The sole removed legacy assertion previously forbade ActorView.GetTags as a future API. Other N5 encapsulation assertions remain intact.
Native fixtures use normal startup, real Players and Reliable transport, and production consumer installation. The N6 server factory wrapper only observes the ordinary awareness instance.
No tests are skipped, no runner selection is changed, and no coverage threshold is reduced. Native Studio runs must be serial because run-in-roblox temporarily installs a shared Studio plugin.
Consumer documentation and production projection/query/event behavior remain for the implementation phase.
